remarks: Nestled at the end of one of Westover's most sought after cul-de-sacs, this exceptional five bedroom residence offers the perfect blend of privacy, elegance, and convenience. Ideally positioned on the Greenwich border, you'll enjoy quick access to downtown Stamford, Metro North, and vibrant downtown Greenwich, while returning home to a peaceful, secluded setting surrounded by nature. Designed with both entertaining and gracious everyday living in mind, the thoughtfully crafted floor plan offers spacious, light filled rooms and an effortless flow throughout. The expansive deck serves as a true outdoor retreat, providing exceptional privacy and generous space for hosting summer gatherings, dining alfresco, or simply relaxing while overlooking the tranquil surroundings. The main level features a separate and private bedroom with an adjacent full bath, creating the perfect accommodations for guests, au pair, or for multigenerational living. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite is a sanctuary all its own. The dramatic vaulted beamed ceiling, a stunning Palladian window, and three oversized closets create an impressive yet inviting space. The spa inspired primary bath offers a whirlpool tub, a walk-in shower, and the comfort of a private retreat at the end of each day. Located in one of Stamford's, most desirable neighborhoods, this home combines timeless style, exceptional privacy, and an unbeatable location to create a truly remarkable place to call home.
